answers.reasoning: max(0,-2)=0. For finite x,exp(-x)>0 so denominator exceeds1 and sigmoid lies strictly between0and1. At -2 exp(2)>1 so sigmoid(-2)=1/(1+exp2)=0.119202922<0.5. Passing negatives through is the wrong activation.

All three sensor limitation pairings match their actual slide panels. Dense camera data do not confer lighting invariance. The source-scoped assumption avoids asserting universal hardware specifications.

The slide explicitly contrasts BFS exponential O(b^d) frontier memory with DFS O(bd) stack/path-related memory. Its assumptions correctly separate finite explored depth from shallowest-goal depth and graph visited-set storage. Reversal and branching-independent bounds are not the stated model.

With left-first plain DFS, each selected left-chain node has another descendant and no goal, so it never backtracks to the root right-child goal. Finite branching does not imply finite depth; shallow goals do not reorder a DFS frontier and automatic BFS switching is absent.

The text-conversation test lists NLP,knowledge representation,automated reasoning,machine learning. Physical appearance computer vision is not in this listed scope. Prior key known; current justification must remove obsolete hydraulic-body prose.
